description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Voidmage Prodigy, adding {U}.
When Voidmage Prodigy dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Voidmage Prodigy from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Voidmage Prodigy's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
